contentHtml:
I get your TVs, sound systems, streaming apps and smart assistants set up correctly and ready to go, whether that is Netflix, Disney+, Stan, Kayo, Binge or the free-to-air apps like ABC iView, SBS On Demand, 7plus, 9Now and 10play. No frustration, no half-day fighting with a remote, for homes and small businesses around Stretton and Brisbane, often same or next day.

End to end, so it just works

  • TV installation and placement. Unboxing, stand setup or wall mounting with tidy cable management.
  • Wi-fi and internet. Tuned for smooth streaming with minimal buffering. For patchy coverage, see my mesh wi-fi service.
  • Streaming apps. Netflix, Stan, Disney+, Amazon Prime, Kayo, Binge and the free-to-air apps, all signed in and ready.
  • Sound and audio. Soundbars, home theatre systems and gaming audio set up so it sounds the way it should.
  • Parental controls. Set up so the kids only reach what you are happy with.

One remote, one setup

I tidy up the inputs and remotes so the whole lounge runs simply, rather than juggling three devices to watch one show. It also ties in nicely with a wider smart home setup, and if your reception is the problem rather than the apps, see my TV antenna installation service.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
